title: Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program Patient Account Policy: Balance, Adjustments, Refunds and Payment Plans
content:
The customer's balance on an Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program is the running total of its patient-balance postings: remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds add to it, and payments and balance adjustments reduce it; a payment is applied to the oldest unpaid posting first. The balance is the amount the customer owes Larkfield on this program, in USD; a negative balance is a credit balance.

## 1. Balance adjustments

A balance adjustment is posted only for one of these reasons, each against the one posting it adjusts and never for more than that posting's unpaid remainder:

| Reason | Use |
|---|---|
| Return credit | An accepted self-pay return, for the price paid for the returned units less the tier's restocking fee percent |
| Secondary payer payment | The amount a secondary payer paid against a remittance's patient responsibility |
| Hardship waiver | Under section 2 |
| Small-balance write-off | Under section 3 |
| Billing correction | A posting made in error, or a timely-filing write-off |

## 2. Hardship waiver

A hardship waiver is granted only on tiers where a hardship waiver is allowed, only for postings named on a hardship application whose request status is approved, and only after Larkfield's financial counseling team confirms household income at or below the tier's hardship income ceiling as a percent of the HHS poverty guideline; it is never granted routinely, never advertised and never granted on the customer's statement alone.

## 3. Small-balance write-off

A small-balance write-off is made only when the whole remaining balance of the program is greater than 0.00 and no more than the tier's small-balance write-off ceiling; on tiers where that ceiling is 0.00 no write-off is made and the balance is statemented.

| Hypothetical case (ceiling of 4.99) | Write-off? |
|---|---|
| Whole remaining balance 4.99 | Yes — no more than the ceiling |
| Whole remaining balance 5.00 | No |
| Whole remaining balance 0.00 | No — the balance must be greater than 0.00 |
| Any balance, on a tier whose ceiling is 0.00 | No — the balance is statemented |

## 4. Credit balance refunds

A credit balance — a balance below zero — is refunded to the original payment method no later than the tier's credit balance refund limit in calendar days after the posting date of the entry that created it, unless the customer asks in writing to keep it on account; a refund never exceeds the credit.

## 5. Payment plans

A payment plan is offered only on tiers where the payment plan maximum months figure is greater than 0, for a balance of at least the tier's payment plan minimum balance, in no more than the maximum months of monthly installments of at least the tier's minimum installment; it is created as a payment plan request the customer accepts, and while an approved plan's installments are current the balance it covers is left out of the past-due test applied to shipment holds.

*Hypothetical case:* on a tier offering plans of up to 10 months with a minimum installment of 20.00 and a minimum balance of 100.00, a balance of 180.00 may be placed on a plan of no more than 9 monthly installments, because ten installments of at least 20.00 each would come to more than the balance; a balance of 95.00 is below the minimum balance and no plan is offered for it.
